items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: Alice and, I've forgotten all their names now, but they were quite well known all over the South here.

ctx.x: Well, they was one of the old show groups. You know, they had the minstrel shows and they had, they had traveled quite a lot over the United States with Whitman sisters. They had, I guess there was minstrels during that time, you know, when they traveled around. And of late, they all, when they went north, they were quite popular and now, it's about three left and one, she's a spiritualist and Alice and, I've forgotten all their names now, but they were quite well known all over the South here.
